sources.excerpt: Published on March 24, 2006 Skreddy Pedals distortion pedal Information Skreddy Pedals Balanced Distortion Skreddy Pedals™ Top Fuel strikes a balance between high gain, sustaining distortion and articulation. No un-useable tones! Neither harsh nor mushy; the string attack is always preserved throughout the entire range of the fretboard, regardless of the sustain level. Tonal emphasis is placed on the midrange in order to showcase the player's technique.
